A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RAIF research. Their complete main texts and appendices, including equations, tables, figures and examples, support comparison after matching relocated and renumbered material.

before.justification: V1 reports original instruction-following experiments, component ablations, judge evaluations and generalization results, including Tables 1–3 and Appendix A.7.

after.justification: V5 retains original experimental results and adds IFBench evaluation and compute measurements in Tables 3 and 5.

M1.justification: The synthesis and verification procedure, GRPO objectives, rule-centric rewards, superior-CoT filtering and behavior cloning remain unchanged. Renaming self-evolving as LLM-based evolving does not introduce an algorithmic component. The revised generator model is a reported implementation setting.

E1.justification: Section 4.4 adds IFBench, described as containing 58 new constraints, introducing an explicit evaluation of following previously unseen constraint types. The original seven instruction benchmarks, bilingual training coverage, and appendix general-purpose and mathematics tasks remain.

E2.justification: Retained comparisons use the same I/O, CoT, SDC and SFT methods, plus Oracle Decomposition, Self-Consistency, Conifer, FollowComplex and Self-Refine on ComplexBench. V5 expands documentation of existing comparators; Tulu 3 is discussed but not experimentally added. LLaMA removals concern entire model configurations.

E3.justification: V5 removes the LLaMA3.1-8B training/evaluation configuration and LLaMA3.3-70B preliminary evaluations. It changes the reported instruction generator from Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct to DeepSeek V3 (v1 Table 7; v5 Table 9) and adds IFBench evaluation using four strict/loose accuracy metrics. The generator revision does not establish that data were regenerated or experiments rerun.

E4.justification: V5 adds unseen-constraint generalization and compute/performance analyses. It removes LLaMA collapse diagnostics, the cross-family training-dynamics figure, and two mathematics-mixture trajectories from Figure 3. The principal component ablations remain unchanged in v1 Table 3 and v5 Table 4.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed information, confidence intervals or significance tests for model performance. The dataset's descriptive mean-and-spread reporting is retained; the new results do not introduce uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: V5 adds IFBench results for six model configurations and compute measurements, including 299 average reasoning tokens for RAIF on ComplexBench. It removes LLaMA results throughout, including v1 Table 1's RAIF average of 4.06 versus its I/O average of 67.01. Matched numerical rows for retained configurations remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1–8, the formal problem definitions and the appendix symbol definitions are retained. V5 adds explanatory assertions, but no new mathematical derivation, formal assumption, theorem or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract and contribution list add an explicit claim of generalization to OOD constraints. The central synthesis-plus-RL contribution, reasoning rationale and headline 1.5B improvement claim remain.

C2.justification: V5 removes explanations of LLaMA collapse and the qualification that improved mathematics reasoning need not transfer to instruction following. It adds explanations for compute tradeoffs, limited larger-model gains and OOD generalization, plus a stronger assertion that every retained CoT is causally linked to better performance. Appendix A.8's general limitations remain substantially unchanged.

D1.justification: V5 Table 3 newly documents comparator training budgets, including SFT/DPO stages, and the text specifies Self-Refine's six-turn limit. Table 9 revises the generator identification to DeepSeek V3. Most appendix hyperparameters, hardware, prompts and decoding details, together with the code/data link targets, are retained.

R1.justification: V5 adds a substantive four-part comparison with Tulu 3 and positions RAIF's OOD generalization against earlier RLVR approaches. It adds IFBench and scaling-related references, among others, while removing the cognitive-behaviors reference associated with the deleted LLaMA discussion. This extends research positioning beyond citation-format changes.

P1.justification: V5 introduces RAIF explicitly, replaces self-evolving terminology, expands selected explanations and adds Section 4.4. It moves the author list into Contributions and changes main-text citation style. Most prose and the overall section and appendix organization remain recognizable.

P2.justification: V5 adopts a branded template with a boxed abstract, revised typography and extensive display resizing and relocation. It adds compute and IFBench tables, relabels Figure 2, reduces Figure 3 from nine panels to six, and removes v1 Figure 35. The other appendix training-dynamics figures are retained and renumbered.

improvement.justification: V5 adds useful evidence about unseen constraints and compute costs. However, it removes the substantial LLaMA failure case and its diagnostic discussion without explanation, while adding a causal guarantee that the unchanged maximum-versus-minimum filtering condition in Equation 7 does not establish. The generator revision also leaves whether training data changed unresolved. These benefits and losses prevent a reliable judgment of the net change in overall quality.
